pages.text: Note that since this uses a $(l:items_blocks_machines/pattern_provider)ME Pattern Provider$(/l), it is meant to integrate into your $(l:ae2_mechanics/autocrafting)autocrafting$(/l) setup.$(br2)Some recipes require items to be thrown into water (though a similar setup can be used to throw items other places). This can be automated with a $(l:items_blocks_machines/formation_plane)ME Formation Plane$(/l), $(l:items_blocks_machines/annihilation_plane)ME Annihilation Plane$(/l), and some supporting infrastructure (this is essentially 2 modified $(l:example_setups/pipe_subnet)pipe$(/l)

$(l:example_setups/pipe_subnet)subnets$(/l)).$(br2)This setup is meant to be used in combination with $(l:example_setups/charger_automation)charger automation$(/l) to provide the $(l:items_blocks_machines/certus_quartz_crystal_charged)Charged Certus Quartz Crystal$(/l)s.$(br2)$(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()$(br2)$(bold)Configurations and Patterns$()$(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/pattern_provider)ME Pattern Provider$(/l) (1) is in its default configuration, with the relevant $(l:items_blocks_machines/patterns)Processing$(/l)
$(l:items_blocks_machines/patterns)Pattern$(/l)s$(li2)For $(l:items_blocks_machines/fluix_crystal)Fluix Crystal$(/l) the default recipe from JEI/REI works fine:

pages.title: Fluix Pattern
pages.text: $(li2)For $(l:items_blocks_machines/budding_certus)Flawed Budding Certus Quartz$(/l) it's probably best to

make it directly from $(l:items_blocks_machines/quartz_block)Certus Quartz Block$(/l), which avoids issues with the input of one recipe being the output of another, causing the storage bus to not be able to filter:
$(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/interface)ME Interface$(/l) (2) is in its default configuration.

$(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/formation_plane)ME Formation Plane$(/l) (3) is set to drop inputs as items.$(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/annihilation_plane)ME Annihilation Plane$(/l) (4) has no GUI and cannot be configured.$(li)The $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_bus)ME Storage Bus$(/l) (5) is filtered to the outputs of the patterns.

pages.title: How It Works
pages.text: 1. The $(l:items_blocks_machines/pattern_provider)ME Pattern Provider$(/l) pushes the ingredients into the $(l:items_blocks_machines/interface)ME Interface$(/l) on its side, on the green subnet$(br2)2. The interface (being configured to not store anything by default) attempts to push its contents into $(l:ae2_mechanics/import_export_storage)network storage$(/l)$(br2)3. The only storage on the green subnet is the $(l:items_blocks_machines/formation_plane)ME Formation Plane$(/l), which drops the items it receives into the

water$(br2)4. The $(l:items_blocks_machines/annihilation_plane)ME Annihilation Plane$(/l) on the orange subnet attempts to pick up the items that were just dropped, but cannot, because the $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_bus)ME Storage Bus$(/l) on top of the pattern provider (the only storage on the orange subnet) is filtered to only accept the results of possible crafts$(br2)5. The items perform their in-world transformation.

6. The annihilation plane can now pick up the items in front of it, as the storage bus is allowed to store them.$(br2)7. The storage bus stores the resulting items in the pattern provider, returning them to the network.
